name: Chalmette
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Chalmette, LA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Chalmette, Louisiana for 2026: Christmas at the Complex, Los Isleños Christmas and Bonfire, Santa on the Bayou and a Nutcracker Tea.
lede: St. Bernard Parish celebrates Christmas with a parish government party in Chalmette and with bonfire and Santa nights at the Los Isleños Museum Complex on Bayou Road.
celebrates: St. Bernard Parish keeps its Christmas close to home. The parish government holds Christmas at the Complex on the first weekend of December at its government complex in Chalmette, and invites local businesses to join in with booths. Down Bayou Road in St. Bernard, the Los Isleños Heritage and Cultural Society opens its museum grounds for a Christmas and Bonfire evening with local school groups singing, followed a week later by Santa on the Bayou. In Arabi, the Maumus Center and Planetarium hosts a Nutcracker Tea. Together they give families a mix of community nights and one ticketed tea.
lastyear: Last December the society's events page shows the Los Isleños Christmas and Bonfire on December 6, 2025 and Santa on the Bayou on December 13, 2025, the same pairing planned again this year. St. Bernard Parish Government also ran its annual Christmas at the Complex celebration in December 2025, which the St. Bernard Voice newspaper covered in a December 18, 2025 article. In 2024, the society opened a decorated drive-through of its museum grounds on December 30.
facts: Los Isleños Heritage and Cultural Society of St. Bernard was organized in 1976 to preserve the language, heritage and traditions of the Canary Islanders who settled in Louisiana between 1778 and 1783. The parish of St. Bernard began along the shores of Bayou Terre aux Boeufs when colonists from Spain's Canary Islands were settled there between 1779 and 1783, according to the society's page. In its 2024 holiday notice the society also pointed visitors to the decorated historic St. Bernard Parish Courthouse and to homes in St. Bernard Village and Toca Village.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in St. Bernard Parish for 2026. The closest holiday train options are across the parish line in New Orleans and the northshore, and our Louisiana Christmas train rides guide lists the Santa trains and steam train rides across the state, so families who want rails with their Christmas can plan a day trip from Chalmette using that list.
traditions: The parish government's yearly Christmas party at its government complex in Chalmette, with local business booths.
An annual evening with local schools singing, decorated grounds and a bonfire after the performances.
The society's Christmas celebration with Santa, listed every December since at least 2023.
The historic St. Bernard Parish Courthouse and homes in St. Bernard Village and Toca Village are decorated for the season.
The Maumus Center and Planetarium in Arabi hosts a tea with morning and afternoon seatings.
kidfact: The Canary Islanders who settled St. Bernard Parish came from Spain's Canary Islands more than 240 years ago, and a museum on Bayou Road still tells their story.
faq: What are the best Christmas events for kids in Chalmette?

Christmas at the Complex, the Los Isleños Christmas and Bonfire, Santa on the Bayou and the Nutcracker Tea at the Maumus Center and Planetarium are the main family events in St. Bernard Parish. Our event cards give the current dates, hours and prices, each checked on the host's own page or an official parish calendar.
Where is the Los Isleños Museum Complex?
It is at 1357 Bayou Road in St. Bernard, Louisiana. The society asks visitors to park in the gravel parking lot next to El Museo de los Isleños.
Does Santa visit St. Bernard Parish?
Yes. Santa on the Bayou is the Los Isleños society's Santa event, held each December, and the parish's Christmas at the Complex is another holiday night for families.
